tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

keywords_matched: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) architecture and modules

cover_en.subject: Application: QA Lead – Automation Testing
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in joining RAJ K. With over 5 years of hands-on backend and enterprise e-commerce engineering experience building, extending, and supporting large-scale platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) architecture and modules.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: Integration & APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, while building optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to keep global channels synchronized.

bullets.label: Quality & Testing
bullets.text: Built automated unit and integration test suites with JUnit to maintain high code quality and coverage, alongside executing CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2).

bullets.label: Cross-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Worked in a techno-functional capacity bridging business and IT, gathering and analysing requirements, mapping processes, supporting user acceptance testing (UAT), and collaborating with international teams.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, enabling an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical expertise can support RAJ K.

tailoring.why_company: Joining RAJ K offers an exciting opportunity to apply my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and SAP Commerce Cloud architecture experience to impactful projects. I am eager to contribute my deep backend engineering background, integration expertise, and rigorous quality focus to help your team build robust, scalable digital solutions.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud architecture and backend engineering experience to drive high-quality technical delivery at RAJ K.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I applied for the QA Lead / SAP Commerce role at RAJ K. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce architecture and backend engineering experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep platform expertise and strong quality focus. I would love to connect and discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: QA Lead – Automation Testing – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the QA Lead position at RAJ K.

With over 5 years of professional experience building, extending, and supporting enterprise platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring a deep understanding of platform architecture, backend integration, and rigorous testing practices.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and can start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
